title: Towards Unified World Models for Visual Navigation via Memory-Augmented Planning and Foresight
abstract: arXiv:2510.08713v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Enabling embodied agents to imagine future states is essential for robust and generalizable visual navigation. Yet, state-of-the-art systems typically rely on modular designs that decouple navigation planning from visual world modeling, which often induces state-action misalignment and weak adaptability in novel or dynamic scenarios. We propose UniWM, a unified, memory-augmented world model that integrates egocentric visual foresight and planning within a single multimodal autoregressive backbone. UniWM explicitly grounds action selection in visually imagined outcomes, tightly aligning prediction with control. Meanwhile, a hierarchical memory mechanism fuses short-term perceptual cues with longer-term trajectory context, supporting stable and coherent reasoning over extended horizons. Extensive experiments on four challenging benchmarks (Go Stanford, ReCon, SCAND, HuRoN) and the 1X Humanoid Dataset show that UniWM improves navigation

translated_title: 迈向基于记忆增强规划与预见性的统一视觉导航世界模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.08713v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：使具身智能体能够想象未来状态对于稳健且可泛化的视觉导航至关重要。然而，最先进的系统通常依赖模块化设计，将导航规划与视觉世界模型分离，这常常导致状态-动作不对齐，并在新颖或动态场景中适应性较弱。我们提出UniWM，一种统一的、记忆增强的世界模型，它在单一多模态自回归骨干网络中集成了自我中心视觉预见和规划。UniWM明确地将动作选择基于视觉想象的输出，紧密对齐预测与控制。同时，分层记忆机制融合了短期感知线索与长期轨迹上下文，支持在扩展时间范围内的稳定和连贯推理。在四个具有挑战性的基准测试（Go Stanford、ReCon、SCAND、HuRoN）和1X人形数据集上的大量实验表明，UniWM改善了导航性能。
tldr: 本文提出UniWM，一种统一的记忆增强世界模型，通过将视觉预见与规划集成到单一自回归框架中，并采用分层记忆机制，有效解决了视觉导航中状态-动作不对齐和长程推理稳定性问题，在多个基准上显著提升了导航性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes UniWM, a unified memory-augmented world model that integrates visual foresight and planning into a single autoregressive framework with hierarchical memory, effectively addressing state-action misalignment and long-horizon reasoning stability in visual navigation, significantly improving navigation performance across multiple benchmarks.
